Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A soldier who fights for the sake of money
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mercenary"** means a soldier who fights for money rather than for a cause. (भाड़े का सैनिक)

 
 
• **Example:** The **mercenary **was hired to protect the convoy through the dangerous terrain.
 
 
 
• **"Mercenary" **refers to someone who is primarily concerned with making money at the expense of ethics. (भाड़े का सैनिक)
 
 
• **Example:** His **mercenary** attitude made him unpopular among his colleagues.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Marine** (समुद्री सैनिक): A member of a military force trained to serve on land and at sea.

 
 
• **Example:** The marine was deployed to assist in the coastal operations.
 
 
 
• **Veteran** (पूर्व सैनिक): A person who has served in the military.
 
 
• **Example:** The veteran shared his war experiences with the younger soldiers.
 
 
 
• **Admiral** (नौसेना अध्यक्ष): A high-ranking officer in the navy.
 
 
• **Example:** The admiral oversaw the entire fleet during the naval exercise.
